title: Didn't work for us
text: Didn't work for us. We bought this on short notice since our old air mattress slowly gave out, but this one is really not the same quality as the old coleman brand we used. The mattress lost just enough air each night, that you would end up with a slighly too soft mattress and both would end up rolling towards the middle. This happened after 2 years of our old coleman being used a couple of weekends a year for friends and family. I think if this is for 1 person only, the mattress will be just fine. I liked the color and that you can store the cable inside a compartment of the air mattress, every convenient and haven't seen that before. Very good inflation and deflation too, if they could work on strenghening the materials and also work on the edge control, this could be a great product for 2. Don't hesitate to try it out when you are a single person, that should work good.
